metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: What I can tell you is this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Iran prior to 1979 viewed itself under the Shah as a kind of a, if not supporter of Israel, was in very good terms with Israel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: They had an embassy in Iran or unofficial embassy in Iran.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: They had certain projects that helping with the agriculture and so forth in Iran.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: But since 1979, that completely reversed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Part of it is that the issue of the Palestinian plight remained very much at the heart of the revolutionary Iranians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: You would see that part of the United States guilt, sin, is to support Israel vis-a-vis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: It's very suppressive, very oppressive treatment of the Palestinians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Completely illegal taking over of the territories which is not theirs since 1967.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And therefore it is upon the Iranian regime, Iranian Islamic Republic, to support the cause of the Palestinians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: This came about at the time when the rest of the support for the Palestinians, including Arab nationalism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: basically reached a stage of bankruptcy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: I mean, much of the regimes of the Arab world either are now coming to terms with Israel or in one way or another

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: because of their own contingencies, because of their own concerns and interests, are really nearly accepting Israel in the region.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Now, that old task of rhetorically supporting the Palestinians falls upon the Islamic Republic

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: that sees itself as a champion of the Palestinians now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Without, as a matter of fact, having either the support of the Iranian people behind them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: If you ask if tomorrow there would be a poll or a referendum,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: I would doubt that 80% of the Iranian people would approve of the policies of the Islamic Republic vis-a-vis the issue of Palestine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Nor the Palestinians themselves because the Islamic Republic is only supporting those factions within the Palestinian movement which are Islamic, quote unquote.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And even within that, there is problems with Hamas, for instance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: But nevertheless, it's for the Islamic Republic some kind of a propaganda tool to be able to use it for its own sake

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: and claim that we are the champions of the Palestinian people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Whether they have a solution, if you look at the rhetoric, if you listen to the rhetoric, it's the destruction of the state of Israel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And that, it seems to me, creates a certain anxiety in the minds of the Israelis, Israeli population, and Israeli government.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Particularly those who are now in power, Netanyahu, the Likud, and more kind of a right-wing politics of, policy of today's Israel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: That being said, I think also the Israelis try to get an extra mileage out of threat of Iran, quote unquote.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: In order to present themselves a rightful for terms of security and whatever else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: The way that they are treating the Palestinians, which I think is extremely unjust, I think is extremely unwise for Israel to carry on with these policies

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: as they did since 1967 at least, and not to try to come to terms with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Of course, there's a huge amount of, I'm not denying that at all, a huge amount of failures, mistakes, and stupidity on the side of the Palestinian leadership

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: in various stages, not to try to make a deal or try to come to terms in some fashion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: But it's a very complex picture, and it's rather unfair to the Palestinians to accuse them for not coming to terms with Israel under a very uneven circumstances

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: when they are not in a position to try to make a fair deal in terms of the territories or in terms of their security in future vis-a-vis Israel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: So I think there is, as you probably know, quite a lot of people that would have a different perspective than you just stated in terms of taking the perspective of Israel

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: in characterizing the situation. Can you steelman their side? Can you steelman Israel's side that they're trying to be a sovereign nation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: trying to protect themselves against threats, ultimately wanting to create a place of safety, a place where people can pursue all the things that you want to pursue in life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: including foremost happiness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: I tend to agree with you, and I have all the respect for the fact that Israel would like to create security and happiness for its own people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: But there are two arguments. One is a moral argument. To my mind as a historian, Jews around the world all through their history suffered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And this is a history of suffering. It's a memory of suffering. And I find it enormously difficult to believe that a nation

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: that's the product of so much sacrifice, suffering, loss of life, and a variety of holocausts above all, would find itself in a position not to give the proper justice

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: to a people who could be their neighbors. And that is a moral argument which I cannot believe under any circumstances can be accepted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Second, in real terms, what do you want? Do you want to commit a genocide? Do you have a population there that you have to come to terms with it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And you cannot just postpone as they did. Since 1967, they're postponing and hoping that it goes away somehow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: I don't think it's going to go away. And it's going to get worse rather than better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: It's a long, nuanced discussion and I look forward to having it. So we'll just leave it there for the moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: But it is a stressful place in the world where the rhetoric is existential, where Iran makes claims that it wants to wipe a country off the face of the earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: It's just the level of intensity of rhetoric is unlike anywhere else in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And extremely dangerous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: In both directions. So one, the real danger of the rhetoric actually being acted upon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And then the extreme political parties using the rhetoric to justify even a greater escalation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: So if Iran is saying that they want to wipe Israel off the face of the earth, that justifies any response.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: On the other side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: On the other side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Of course, I tend to agree with you fully. And unfortunately, this is a very critical situation that this region is facing, Iran in particular.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: I would say that I hope that in the minds of the people of Israel, there is enough or common sense to realize that probably escalation on the Israeli side is not in the favor of anybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And try to let the Iranians to go on with their empty rhetoric as they do so far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: But at the same time, I cannot deny the fact that there is a danger on the side of this regime and what it says.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: It cannot be denied. Nobody can justify that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Particularly because the Iranian population is not behind this regime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Certainly in the case of the Palestinians. Or for that matter, it's not Palestine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: It's the Islamic Republic's involvement in Lebanon with Hezbollah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: It's the Islamic Republic's involvement in Syria with Bashar Assad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: It's involvement in other parts of the world, perhaps even Yemen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: That all of them creates extraterritorial responsibilities or interventions, unnecessary interventions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: that ultimately is not in favor of the best interests of the Iranian people or Iran as a country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Iran has never been involved in this kind of politics before of the Islamic Republic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: So in a sense, the Iranian regime, it seems to me, by going to the extreme,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: tried to create for itself a space that it did not have or did not deserve to have within the politics of the region.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: In other words, that has become part of the tool, kind of an instrument for, if you like to call it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: some kind of an expansionism of the regime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: In parts of the world where it can see there is a possibility for its presence, for its expansion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Of course, historically speaking, Iran, ever since the 15th century, I think that's the earliest example I can see,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: in early modern times, has always a tendency of moving in the direction of not only what is today the state of Iraq,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: but further into the eastern coast of Mediterranean.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: So that's a long-term ambition that has been in the cards as far as Iran as a strategic unit is concerned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: But by no means justified and by no means could be a reasonable, could be a sane policy of a nation state as today's Iran.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: But the second point is that also regimes are always victims of their own rhetoric.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: So once you keep repeating something, then you become more and more committed to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And it cannot remain anymore in the level of a rhetoric. You have to do something about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: So it's some compelling pressure to try to materialize what you've been saying in your rhetoric.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And that is even extremely more dangerous as far as Iran is concerned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And it brings it to some unholy alliances that today we are witnessing Iran is getting involved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Even more dangerous than this rhetoric in terms of the vis-a-vis Israel is its involvement with Russia and to some extent with China, which we can talk about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: What do you think about the meeting between Harmony and Vladimir Putin in July?

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: What's that alliance? What's that partnership? Is it surface-level geopolitics?

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Is there a deep growing connection?

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: I cannot see the difference between geopolitics and these deep connections. I see this one and the same.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Why? Because I think the experience of 40 years of distancing from the West in terms of the Islamic Republic

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: and the fact that there is a shelf life to imperial presence for any empire anywhere in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: So after the terrible experience of the United States in Iraq and in Afghanistan,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: pretty much like the British Empire that after the Suez experience in 1956 decided to withdraw from east of Suez.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Maybe there is a moment here that we are witnessing or it may come that a great power like the United States sees in its benefit

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: not to get too much involved into nitty-gritty things in other parts of the world that it's not its immediate concern.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And I think that is part of the reason, not the entire reason, part of the reason why we see the emergence of a new geopolitical environment

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: in this part of the world of which China, Russia, possibly Iran, possibly Turkey, possibly both of them are going to be part.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Perhaps Saudis also, but I doubt that the Saudis under the present circumstances,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: although we have witnessed some remarkable issue in the course of the past few weeks

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: where the Saudis giving assurances to American administration and then shifting and getting along with Putin

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: in terms of the oil production, I think it's more than that even.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And it's not only them, but also the Emirates are doing the same thing. So what does that tell us?

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And that's another many hour conversation about the oil industry in Iran and the whole region.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: In emerging this kind of a world which was perhaps even 10 years ago unimaginable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: That you see now a great power, China, that it's going to remain from what we see around us as a great power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: And Russia, adventurous, foolish, but nevertheless would remain criminal, I would say, as far as its behavior in Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: But actually it's a rogue nation that attracts another rogue nation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: So Iran finds itself now in a greater place of security in alliance with Russia

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: in the hope that this would give Iran a greater security in this part of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Whether this is realistic or illusion, I think remains to be seen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: I think Iran-China relation makes more sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Although if you ask ordinary Iranians, they don't like it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: They would tell why should we be tied up with China as the only trade party with America

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: because of the foolish isolations that you have created for us,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: because of all the sanctions that you have created for us, the Islamic Republic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: So in a sense it's a very difficult question to answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Probably Iranians also like to be more on the other camp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: But what happens is that in the real term, what surprises me most is not this alliance with China,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: but it's kind of becoming a lackey or subservient to Putin's regime in Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: Since if you look at it, Iran ever since at least the 19th century, not going further back,

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: the beginning of the 19th century always viewed Russia as the greatest threat strategically

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: because it was sitting right at the top of Iran.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

body.input: It was infinitely more powerful than Iran has ever been.

metadata.title: Podcast: Abbas Amanat: Iran Protests, Mahsa Amini, History, CIA & Nuclear Weapons | Lex Fridman Podcast #334

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: keep it to just physical force?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: In saying that you have an intuition

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that force might be with us much longer than violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I think the two bleed together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: So take, because it's always my go-to example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I'm afraid and I'm sure that the listeners all hate it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: but take Germany during the 1920s, early 1930s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: before the Nazis came to power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And they were always involved in some level of force,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: beating up in the streets or whatever it might be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: But think about it more like an intellectual discussion

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: until a certain point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: Is that it would be difficult, I imagine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: to keep the intellectual counter-force of ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: from at some point degenerating into something

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that's more coercion, counter-force,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: if we wanna use the phrases we were just talking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: So I think the two are intimately connected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I mean, actions follow thought, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And at a certain point, I think especially

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: when one is not achieving the goals

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that they want to achieve through a peaceful discussion

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: or argumentation or trying to convince the other side

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that sometimes the next level of operations

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: is something a little bit more physically imposing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: if that makes sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: We go from the intellectual to the physical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: Yeah, so it too easily spills over into violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: Yes, and one leads to the other often.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: So you kind of implied perhaps a hopeful message,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: but let me ask it in the form of a question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: Do you think we'll always have war?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I think it goes to the fourth question too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: So for example, what do you do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I mean, let's play with nation states now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: although I don't know that nation states

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: are something we should think of

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: as a permanent construct forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: Oh, interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: But how is one nation state supposed to prevent

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: another nation state from acting in ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that it would see as either detrimental

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: to the global community or detrimental

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: to the interest of their own nation state?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And I think we've had this question

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: going back to ancient times,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: but certainly in the 20th century,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: this has come up quite a bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I mean, the whole second World War argument

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: sometimes revolves around the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: of what the proper counterforce should be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: Can you create an entity, a League of Nations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: a United Nations, a one world entity maybe even

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that alleviates the need for counterforce

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: involving mass violence and armies and navies

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and those things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I think that's an open discussion we're still having.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: It's good to think through that

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: because having a United Nations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: there's usually a centralized control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: So there's humans at the top,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: there's committees and usually like leaders emerge

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: as singular figures that then can become corrupted by power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And it's just a really important,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: it feels like a really important thought experiment

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and something to really rigorously think through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: How can you construct systems of government

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that are stable enough to push us towards less and less war

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and less and less unstable and another tough word

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: which is unfair of application of force?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: You know, that's really at the core of the question

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that we're trying to figure out as humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: As our weapons get better and better

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and better destroying ourselves,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: it feels like it's important to think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: how we minimize the over application

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: or unfair application of force.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: There's other elements that come into play too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: You and I are discussing this

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: at the very high intellectual level of things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: but there's also a tail wagging the dog element to this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: So think of a society of warriors,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: a tribal society from a long time ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: How much do the fact that you have warriors in your society

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and that their reason for existing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: what they take pride in, what they train for,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: their status in their own civilization,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: how much does that itself drive

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: the responses of that society, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: How much do you need war to legitimize warriors?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: That's the old argument that you get to

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and we've had this in the 20th century too,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that the creation of arms and armies

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: creates an incentive to use them, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And that they themselves can drive that incentive

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: as a justification for their reasons for existence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: That's where we start to talk about the interactivity

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: of all these different elements of society upon one another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: So when we talk about governments and war,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: well, you need to take into account the various things

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: those governments have put into place

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: in terms of systems and armies and things like that

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: to protect themselves, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: For reasons we can all understand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: but they exert a force on your range of choices, don't they?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: It's true, you're making me realize that in my upbringing

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and I think upbringing of many warriors are heroes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: To me, I don't know where that feeling comes from,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: but to sort of die fighting

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: is an honorable way to die, it feels like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I've always had a problem with this

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: because as a person interested in military history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: the distinction is important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And I try to make it at different levels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: So at base level, the people who are out there

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: on the front lines doing the fighting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: to me, those people can be compared with police officers

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and firemen and people, fire persons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: But I mean, people that are involved

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: in an ethical attempt to perform a task

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: which ultimately one can see in many situations

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: as being a saving sort of task, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: Or if nothing else, a self-sacrifice

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: for what they see as the greater good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: Now, I draw a distinction between the individuals

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and the entity that they're a part of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: A military, and I certainly draw a distinction

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: between the military and then the entire,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: for lack of a better word, military industrial complex

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that that service is a part of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I feel a lot less moral attachment

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: to those upper echelons than I do the people on the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: The people on the ground could be any of us

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and have been in a lot of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: we have a very professional sort of military now

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: where it's a very, a subset of the population.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: But in other periods of time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: we've had conscription and drafts

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and it hasn't been a subset of the population.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: It's been the population, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And so it is the society oftentimes going to war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And I make a distinction between those warriors

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and the entities either in the system

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that they're a part of the military

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: or the people that control the military

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: at the highest political levels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I feel a lot less moral attachment to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And I'm much harsher about how I feel about them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I do not consider the military itself to be heroic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And I do not consider

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: the military industrial complex to be heroic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I do think that is a tail wagging the dog situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I do think that draws us into looking at military endeavors

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: as a solution to the problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: much more quickly than we otherwise might.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And to be honest, to tie it all together,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I actually look at the victims of this

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: as the soldiers we were talking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: If you set a fire to send firemen into to fight,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: then I feel bad for the firemen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I feel like you've abused the trust

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that you give those people, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: So when people talk about war,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I always think that the people that we have to make sure

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that a war is really necessary in order to protect

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: are the people that you're gonna send over there

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: to fight that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: The greatest victims in our society of war

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: are often the warriors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: So in my mind, when we see these people coming home

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: from places like Iraq,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: a place where I would have made the argument

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and did at the time that we didn't belong,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: to me, those people are victims.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And I know they don't like to think about themselves that way

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: because it runs totally counter to the ethos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: But if you're sending people to protect this country shores,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: those are heroes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: If you're sending people to go do something

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that they otherwise probably don't need to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: but they're there for political reasons

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: or anything else you wanna put in

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that's not defense related,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: well, then you've made victims of our heroes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And so I feel like we do a lot of talk about our troops

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and our soldiers and stuff,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: but we don't treat them as valuable

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: as the rhetoric makes them sound.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: Otherwise we would be much more careful

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: about where we put them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: If you're gonna send my son,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and I don't have a son, I have daughters,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: but if you're gonna send my son into harm's way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: I'm going to demand that you really need

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: to be sending him into harm's way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And I'm going to be angry at you

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: if you put him into harm's way if it doesn't warrant it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: And so I have much more suspicion about the system

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that sends these people into these situations

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: where they're required to be heroic

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: than I do the people on the ground

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: that I look at as either the people that are defending us

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: The first need to do that is to try to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

body.input: and one that is totally interwoven in our entire society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136

metadata.title: Podcast: Dan Carlin: Hardcore History | Lex Fridman Podcast #136
