metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: how we can build a better world together,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: to find hope for the future,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and to rediscover each time through the exploration of ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: just how beautiful this life is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: This, our human civilization, in all of its full complexity,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: the forces of good and evil,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: of war and peace, of hate and love.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I don't think I can do this with a heart and mind

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: that is not open, fragile,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and willing to empathize with all human beings,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: even those in the darkest corners of our world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: To attack is easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: To understand is hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: And I choose the hard path.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I have learned over the past few months

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: that this path involves me getting more and more attack

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: from all sides.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I will get attacked when I host people

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: like Jay Bhattacharya or Francis Collins,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Jamie Mertzel or Vincent Racinello,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: when I stand for my friend Joe Rogan,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: when I host tech leaders like Mark Zuckerberg,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Elon Musk and others,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: when I eventually talk to Vladimir Putin,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Barack Obama, and other figures

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: that have turned the tides of history.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I have, and I will, get called stupid, naive, weak,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and I will take these words with respect, humility, and love,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and I will get better.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I will listen, think, learn, and improve.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: One thing I can promise is there's no amount of money

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: or fame that can buy my opinion

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: or make me go against my principles.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: There's no amount of pressure that can break my integrity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: There's nothing in this world I need

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: that I don't already have.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Life itself is the fundamental gift.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Everything else is just a bonus.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: That is freedom.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: That is happiness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: If I die today, I will die a happy man.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Now, a few comments about my approach

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and lessons learned from the Albert Berla conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: The goal was to reveal as much as I could

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: about the human being before me,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and to give him the opportunity to contemplate in long form

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: the complexities of his role,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: including the tension between making money

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and helping people,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: the corruption that so often permeates human institutions,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: the crafting of narratives through advertisements,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I only had one hour,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: so this wasn't the time to address these issues deeply,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: but to show if Albert struggled with them

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: in the privacy of his own mind,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and if he would, let down the veil of political speak

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: for a time to let me connect with a man

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: who decades ago chose to become a veterinarian,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: who wanted to help lessen the amount

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: of suffering in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I had no pressure placed on me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: There were no rules.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: The questions I was asking were all mine

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and not seen by Pfizer folks.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I had no care whether I ever talked to another CEO again.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: None of this was part of the calculation

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: in my limited brain computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I didn't want to grill him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: The way politicians grill CEOs in Congress,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I thought that this approach is easy,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: self-serving, dehumanizing, and it reveals nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I wanted to reveal the genuine intellectual struggle,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: vision, and motivation of a human being,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and if that fails,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I trusted the listener to draw their own conclusion

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and insights from the result,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: whether it's the words spoken,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: or the words left unspoken,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: or simply the silence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: And that's just it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I fundamentally trust the intelligence of the listener, you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: In fact, if I criticize the person too hard

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: or celebrate the person too much,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I feel I fail to give the listener

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: a picture of the human being that is uncontaminated

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: by my opinion or the opinion of the crowd.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I trust that you have the fortitude and the courage

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: to use your own mind, to empathize, and to think.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Two practical lessons I took away.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: First, I will more strongly push

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: for longer conversations of three, four, or more hours

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: versus just one hour.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: 60 minutes is too short for the guest to relax

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and to think slowly and deeply,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and for me to ask many follow-up questions

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: or follow interesting tangents.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Ultimately, I think it's in the interest of everyone,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: including the guest,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: that we talk in true long form for many hours.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Second, these conversations will lead to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: a more

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and more intense conversation with the audience.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I think that conversations with leaders

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: can be aided by further conversations with people

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: who wrote books about those leaders or their industries.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Those that can steal man each perspective

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and attempt to give an objective analysis.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I think of Teddy Roosevelt's speech

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: about the man in the arena.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I want to talk to both the men and women in the arena

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and the critics and the supporters in the stands.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: For the latter, I lean towards

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: understanding the ideas themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: That's why I wanted to have this conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: with John Abramson,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: who is an outspoken critic of the pharmaceutical industry.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I hope it helps add context and depth

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: to the conversation I had with the Pfizer CEO.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: In the end, I may do worse than I could have or should have.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Always, I will listen to the criticisms without ego,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and I promise I will work hard to improve.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: But let me say finally, that cynicism is easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Optimism, true optimism is hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: It is the belief that we can and we will

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: build a better world

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and that we can only do it together.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: This is the fight worth fighting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: So here we go.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Once more into the breach, dear friends.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I love you all.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: To support it, please check out our sponsors

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: And now here's my conversation with John Abramson.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Your faculty at Harvard Medical School,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: your family physician for over two decades,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: rated one of the best family physicians in Massachusetts.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: You wrote the book, Overdosed America,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and the new book coming out now called Sickening

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: about how Big Pharma broke American healthcare,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: including science and research and how we can fix it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: First question, what is the biggest problem with Big Pharma

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: that if fixed would be the most impactful?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: So if you can snap your fingers and fix one thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: what would be the most impactful you think?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: The biggest problem is the way they

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: determine the content, the accuracy and the completeness

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: of what doctors believe to be the full range of knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: that they need to best take care of their patients.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: So that with the knowledge having been taken over

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: by the commercial interests,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: primarily the pharmaceutical industry,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: the purpose of that knowledge is to maximize the profits

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: that get returned to investors and shareholders

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and not to optimize the health of the American people.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: So rebalancing that equation would be the most important

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: thing to do to get our healthcare back

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: aimed in the right direction.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Okay, so there's a tension between helping people

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and making money.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: So if we look at particularly the task of helping people

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: in medicine and healthcare, is it possible if money

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: is the primary sort of mechanism by which you achieve that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: as a motivator, is it possible to get that right?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I think it is Lex, but I think it is not possible

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: without guardrails that maintain the integrity

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and the balance of the knowledge.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Without those guardrails, it's like trying to play

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: a professional basketball game without referees

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and having players call their own fouls.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: But the players are paid to win and you can't count on them

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: to call their own fouls.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: So we have referees who are in charge.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: We don't have those referees in American healthcare.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: That's the biggest way that American healthcare

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: is distinguished from healthcare and other wealthy nations.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: So okay, so you mentioned Milton Friedman

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and you mentioned his book called Capitalism and Freedom.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: He writes that there are only three legitimate functions

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: of government to preserve law and order,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: to enforce private contracts, and to ensure

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: that private markets work.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: You said that that was a radical idea at the time,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: but we're failing on all three.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: How are we failing?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: And also maybe the bigger picture is what are the strengths

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and weaknesses of capitalism when it comes to medicine

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and healthcare?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: Can we separate those out because those are two huge questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: So how we're failing in all three,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and these are the minimal functions that our guru

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: of free market capitalism said the government should perform.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: So this is the absolute baseline.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: On preserving law and order,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: the drug companies routinely violate the law

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: in terms of their marketing,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and in terms of their presentation

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: of the results of their trials.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I know this because I was an expert in litigation

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: for about 10 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: I presented some of what I learned in civil litigation

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: to the FBI and the Department of Justice,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: and that case led to the biggest criminal fine

metadata.title: Podcast: John Abramson: Big Pharma | Lex Fridman Podcast #263

body.input: in US history as of 2010.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He worked for Pablo Escobar and Jorge Ochoa, the leaders behind the Medellin Cartel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Roger was the employer and close friend of Barry Seal, the infamous drug smuggler

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: who was the main character in the movie American Maid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Roger transported countless tons of cocaine and marijuana covering six continents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He escaped prison five times, was shut down in both Mexico and Colombia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and was tortured, nearly to death, in a Mexican prison.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Through all of this, his wife Mari, the love of his life, was there with him,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and when he was in prison, she waited for him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He recently got out of prison, where for many years he worked on his memoir called Smuggler.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: This podcast is an exploration of his story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Let me say a few words about Roger Reeves, Pablo Escobar, and the war on drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: This conversation with Roger is unlike any I've ever done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: In the eyes of many, including the law, Roger is a criminal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: A bad man who has added to the suffering in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: But he never directly engaged or participated in the violence, unlike his bosses, Pablo Escobar

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and Jorge Ochoa.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: His crime was the transport of drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I thought about this, and about Pablo Escobar, who was at once both a brutal murderer and a

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Robin Hood figure who helped the poor and was loved by thousands, if not millions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: We sometimes idolize murderers and destroy good honest men.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: We give power and money to corrupt politicians and dictators that starve and murder their own people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Given this, I think about what makes for a good man, and what makes for a bad man, and who decides.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Sitting across from Roger, I saw a complicated man, but one who has kindness in his heart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: A love for money and adventure, and a disdain for violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Again, his crime was the transport of drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Since 1971, the war on drugs has cost US $1 trillion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Marijuana legalization alone would save and make $13.7 billion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: That could send more than 650,000 students to public universities every year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Then there's the human stories of the 500,000 human beings sitting in prison for drug-related

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: offenses and the 1.1 million on probation and parole.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Their life is damaged or ruined beyond repair due to the prohibition of drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: There's a lot more to be said about the damage done by the war on drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: But when reading about Roger's story and talking to him, I couldn't escape the thought that while

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: society wants to label him a criminal and a bad human being, there are much worse men out there

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: who we give a pass to, even give power to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Even men who hold political office or run companies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I also think about my role as an interviewer, sitting across a man like Roger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: In these interviews, in life, in many ways I continue to be myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: A person who like Dostoyevsky's The Idiot seeks the good in all people, but is hurt by it on

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: occasion and maybe is destroyed by it in the end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I'm not naive, but I'm also optimistic and have hope for humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: That's who I am.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And that's what these conversations are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I hope you join me and I hope you understand that I come from a place of love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman podcast and here's my conversation with Roger Reeves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: You are one of the most prolific drug smugglers in history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: What would you say motivated you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Money, power, the thrill, or was it something else?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: But isn't there a point where you can't be a drug smuggler?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: But isn't there a point where you've had more money that you can possibly know what to do with?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Or is it always more money?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: You know, I had plenty of money several times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And I think it's sort of like if you was in Las Vegas and you had the slot machine handled down

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and the gold coins were tumbling around you and you had sweepers

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: bagging them up, when would you let it go?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: But isn't some part of that the thrill then?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Oh, there was a lot of thrill, sometimes way too much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: You made certainly tens of millions of dollars, probably much more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: What memorable experience did having that much money make possible for you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So there's one thing is the money and the other thing is what that money can buy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Well, I bought everything that I could hide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I bought seven farms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I owned the city, the land where the city of Marino Valley, California is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I had an option on that land, did the planning and development of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: The most expensive coin in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Yachts, ships, airplanes, glory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Did that bring you happiness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: No, absolutely not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: In fact, I think I'm happier now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I know I'm happier now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So looking back, would you do it the same way all again?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: No way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Really?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Even the thrill of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Not even the thrill of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: It wasn't worth 33 years in prison being away from my lovely family.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So money, what about the power?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Just being on top of the world where nobody can, not the governments, the police,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: all the big bad agencies chasing you and you could do whatever the heck you wanted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: As far as having to look over your shoulder everywhere you went and every phone call you

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: made, make sure that you were naked with somebody in the ocean before you talked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: It was rather uncomfortable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I like to make phone calls the same way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: What was it like meeting and working with Pablo Escobar, the leader of the Medellín Cartel?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He just seemed like a gentleman when I met him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He was just like you and I sitting here shook hands and I had flown one load for a fellow and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: it didn't work out well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: The fellow that I gave it to got shot and it took a while to get my money and they didn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: put as many kilos on the plane as they're supposed to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So I wasn't going to work with him anymore and my contact down there introduced me to Jorge Ochoa.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: We went up in Envigada, we went up and the gate opened and we was escorted in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: There must have been 50 men out in the yards hitching rail on an old house

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and we were escorted right in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: There was a beautiful woman in there, I mean, gore, drop dead beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: She made us a cup of coffee and then we ushered in to see Jorge Ochoa.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He had 12 telephones on his desk and all of them was a different color.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He shook hands, was very friendly, spoke English.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And he said that each one of those telephones were represented in another city in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: This is Chicago and this is New York.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: If I ring, I knew who's calling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And so we chatted a while and he asked me what type of airplanes I had

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and what experience I had flying across the US border.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And I told him he seemed pleased with it and he called the lady in and she went next door

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and came Pablo Escobar and he introduced me to Pablo Escobar and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: he asked the same questions again and I answered him and I said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and I asked him how much he paid and he paid $5,000 a kilo to haul it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And so I said, how much you put on the plane?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199
Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So that's one and a half, two and a half million dollars for an eight hour trip.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Sounded pretty good to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And we're talking about cocaine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Cocaine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And we're talking about Columbia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Columbia and cocaine and Medellín Cartel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And Jorge Ochoa was one of the, what would you say, founding members of the committee?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He was probably the brains behind the whole thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: The brains and spoke good English.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And they were nice people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Really nice people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Were you scared?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Not at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: What's wrong with your mind that you weren't scared?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Here's some of the most dangerous men in this world and you weren't scared.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Well, I knew I was going to do exactly what I said I was going to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Mari and the children were down there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: They went down and they stayed in the hotel, five star, treated royally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: On my first load.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And they just did ask security to make sure that I wasn't a DEA agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So I did the first load and they can say they were hostages, but they really weren't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: It was just insurance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So there was some integrity to the way they operated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Completely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I mean, straight up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: The money was ironed and banded and just right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And the numbers would never once anything wrong with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: What would you attribute that honesty to within their own moral system and their own set of rules?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Why weren't people crossing the line and shaving off the top and injecting chaos into the system

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: to where it would be unpredictable and people would be dishonest and greedy and all those kinds of things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: That's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Most people are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: But there's certain people at the top of the food chain that they don't need that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And if they're completely honest, then they don't have to think of, remember the lie they told.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And plus they're just honest to start with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: They're making plenty of money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: They was making as much money as I did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I'll tell you how that came about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I understand that 10,000 people were killed every year in Medellin, Colombia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And what they were doing, they didn't have any organization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And if one fellow had 10 kilos and he wanted it shipped to New York, he would tell his friend.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: His friend says, sure, I'll ship it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I have a pilot and I'll ship it up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And then he would look in the newspapers, oh, 40 kilos was busted in New Jersey.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I'm so sorry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Yours got busted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Bang, bang.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He's dead.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So here comes Jorge Ochoa and the three Ochoa brothers and Pablo Escobar and Gacho.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And they decided that we will make an insurance company, that we would charge you $10,000

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: to take it to your contact in Miami.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: If it gets lost anywhere between the time I put it on the airplane or the time you give it to us

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and the time we give it to your man, we will replace it in Colombia for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So there was no way anybody could lose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And I understand they got 100 tons piled up under that insurance program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And I was right there the first day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So I had all the work I could do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I would land and I said, when you want me to come back, we're waiting on you, señor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Well, let me ask a difficult question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Some see Escobar as a brutal murderer and some see him as maybe a Robin Hood-like figure

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: who helped the poor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: How do you see the man?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Both of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I think he started out, to be honest, with helping the poor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And then they had a war down there and they blew up and killed his people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And the country was divided almost equally three ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: They had the military.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: They were just as much into it as anybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And then you had the fart guerrillas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: They had about a third of the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And then you had the contras.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: It was like the white farmers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And they're the ones that I was dealing with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And they were at war with one another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And so if one of them started killing their people, well, I'll kill some of yours too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So that's how it happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And then when I heard about Pablo Escobar blowing up that airliner and killing those women and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: children, I was sorry I ever shook his hand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: That's brutal murder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So you would say Escobar is not a good man?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Not at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: It's terrible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Now, looking back on it, when I met him, he was good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He did just exactly what he said he would do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Could he be a bad man and a man you can trust?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Are those the two?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: You could trust him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So from your perspective, in terms of business, he was reliable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He was honest, had integrity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: You could work with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Oh, completely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: We flew up to his ranch and he brought out motorcycles to start with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Can you ride a motorcycle?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Of course I can ride a motorcycle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So I took off across the grass and there was a little ditch there and the front wheel dropped

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: in that thing and I must have slid across that grass 20 feet before I got stopped.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He almost fell off his bike waiting because they knew what it was going to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And then we got on horses and went out there and pretended to round up some cows and he

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: put a Mach 10 machine gun pistol over my shoulder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: You know how to use this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Well, I never had, but it was all right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I think it was like, okay, you got 10 bodyguards.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: You got 10 bodyguards. What do you need me for?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So that's the kind of time we laughed and talked and drove some cows over the stumps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: You said Jorge Ochoa was perhaps the brains of the Medellin cartel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: What was he like and why do you say he was the brains?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Well, he was a gentleman and I suppose he shipped, you know, tell me how many more

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: times of cocaine than Pablo did. Him and his brothers, you could tell by the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: they had on each load, they was in duffel bags and it's big football shaped fluffy stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: made with ether. And they would have three horns on it or a rattlesnake or four Xs on each bag.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: You kind of got to know which was which and they shipped a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So, and he was just a gentleman. I took the family. We went one weekend to his ranch or his

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: palacio place out near Barranquilla and oh, he just treated the family. His family had

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: his younger brother made a bullfight and we had skiing and little airplanes on floats on the water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: It was really nice and he was really nice. How do you make sense of the tension that a man

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: could be a gentleman, can have integrity, but also be a murderer?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Well, murder is a stronger word than killing. Can you explain the line, the gray area we're talking

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: about? I mean, I've just talking with Jaco Willink and we talked a lot about killing in the context

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: of military conflict and in the context of war. So there, there's a line between murder and killing

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: that you can draw. What's the line that you're referring to? It's something similar. If people

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: shooting at you and you shoot back and kill him, that's not murder whatsoever. He's trying to get

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: away or out of the situation. But if some woman don't pay you and you send a hitman over to kill

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: her and her children, that's murder. Was Jorge involved in those kinds of things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I don't think so at all. I mean, he was just such a gentleman. He had a restaurant before and he

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: was just smart. I understand that the first 10 kilos he sold, he was sitting on a motorcycle in

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the sidelines in a parking lot. When the DEA come in, he sped away. So he didn't come back to America.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He was just smart. Some people are savvy. He was such a gentleman and the whole family,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the mother and the father, the two brothers, their sister, I was there when she was kidnapped.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And finally he kidnapped our, I guess, a hundred leaders of the FARC and said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: all right, when she don't come back, none of these are going to come back. So they made a deal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Is there something you can say about the power structure, the hierarchy of the Midian cartel

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: that you interacted with? Was it a dictatorship where Pablo ran everything? Was there a bunch of

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: power centers? Was it like a company where you have CEO, CTO kind of thing, and then there's

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: like managers and all those kinds of things. How did it run from a leadership perspective?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I understand that about five of them got together and made this, I will call it an insurance company

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and now known as the Midian cartel. And I didn't see any difference. Each one of them had their own

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: business and their people from the jungle or wherever made the cocaine, gave it to them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and they shipped it. And so it didn't seem to be any power play between them at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: But my main contact was Jorge Ochoa and Pablo Escobar was right there. And I saw plenty of stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: for him too. It's strange that they didn't betray each other regularly. Greed makes men betray each

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: other. How do you explain that? How much betrayal did you see? I didn't see any, absolutely none.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: If they shipped his hundred kilos, he got paid for it. If the other one shipped his, I'm sure

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: they got paid for it. How do you explain that? Well, there was no need to. The money was just

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: unbelievable. You think about 500 kilos in the plane at $50,000 a kilo at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And they paid $5,000 to ship it. And they made 5,000 without even touching it. They just had

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: somebody to load it on through the airplane. I gave it to their man in Miami. They gave it to

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: whoever it belonged to by the marks on the duffel bags. So they was making just untold millions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: No reason. But greed can blind men. It's still strange to me that there was not more betrayal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: It speaks to something else perhaps that's bigger than money. Maybe not. But it seems just like in

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the casino, like you mentioned, we get accustomed to whatever level of money we have, we get accustomed

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: very quickly. And then there's a tension that's natural between human beings. And when that tension

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: combined with money, combined with power, combined with, like you mentioned, beautiful women
