metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and a bit of violence, it seems that betrayal should be commonplace. But it's not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: It wasn't. Not at all. Carlos Later, I don't know if he betrayed anybody, but he started that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He was running cocaine through the Bahamas and he had the island. I was offered to fly

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: with a DC-3 with that, but I didn't like it. So I had my route through the old wheels in Louisiana.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So I wasn't going to change, but he talked a lot and I don't know if he betrayed, but they didn't like him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Yeah. So as you expand, there could be tensions that lead to conflict. Colombia was, like you said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: an ultra-violent place. How did you survive? Who protected you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I was a hero. They liked me. I mean, I was just treated royally. All I did, I would come over El

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Banco. There's a radio station at the Forks of the Magdalena River, I believe at 720 if I remember

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: right, on the AM. And I'd fly in at 10,000 feet and I'd see below me there'd be a Cessna.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And I'd wiggle my wings and he'd wiggle his and I'd fall in behind him and we might go 100, 200

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: miles. I'd land on some jungle strip or some banana plantation and they'd fuel me up. I could eat

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: steak in the night. It was just like treated royally. I mean, take off the next morning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: whenever I wanted to, it was just like that was protected. And I was an honored guest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: It wasn't anything like in that movie putting a gun to your head and taking your sunglasses and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: betting. So one time I complained to Jorge Ochoa that the runway was pretty short that they were

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: using. And I went back down and it looked like Los Angeles International. They had bulldozers in

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: there. Had that thing 5,000 feet long. Just like just the next week it was all done. The jungle was

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: gone and clay put up there. And all the while you were not afraid. You were treated like royalty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Yes, there I was. I was afraid when I landed in the United States. Well, maybe let's go back to the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: beginning. What was the first time you flew an airplane with drugs on it? Tell me the story of

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the first time you smuggled drugs. All right. I flew down to Jalapa Veracruz with a Cessna 182.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And we landed at the town. It was a lovely town. And this old town looked like Bible times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Women were washing their clothes in the streets with stone basins and the stream running through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I just was just dumbstruck. It was just so pretty. And I went in a church, a Catholic church,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and it had the Stations of the Cross all carved magnificent. I had never seen that. And I come

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: home and told Mary about that. That just almost brought tears to my eyes. It was so beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And three o'clock the next morning I went out to the airport and taxied down to the taxiway. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: there was a guard came out and wanted to know what I was doing. And I pulled out. I was on the fire

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: department out in Redondo Beach, California. So I pulled out my wallet and it was the fire department

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: badge. And oh, he shook my hand and was so glad. So I taxied on down there and we loaded up about

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: 400 pounds in the plane and came on back. And I was running the headwinds more than I thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And I landed on a little strip. You're talking about on the way back?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: On the way back, on the way north after we loaded up early in the morning. And for the only time I

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: ever got vertigo, the mountains were coming down at a 30 or 40 degree angle and the Milky Way was

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: overhead. And somehow I wanted that airplane to be level with the stars. And it got me in it. It's

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: just a phenomenon. Paul has vertigo. It's the only time I ever had it was on that load. So anyway,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the wind was on the nose of that system. I wasn't going to make it to the dry lake where I had fuel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So I landed on a little bitty strip and there was a little house it was caved in and it was a little

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: boy named Lazarus about six or seven years old. And he was herding some goats. So we put the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: marijuana in that house and the man stayed with it while I flew into some town and got fuel and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: came back and we sat down with the lunch that I brought back and little Lazarus sat there and ate

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: with us and we had a good time. We loaded him back and came home. Oh, wow. I wonder where he is now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: What was it like to fly, maybe describe the details of, do you have to fly low?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Is there details that are unique to this experience of flying an airplane with drugs on it, on board?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: All right. Well, one of the mistakes that just thousands, hundreds and hundreds and thousands

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: of pilots make, they don't stop at the border going down and get their permit. Once you get a

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: permit to be in Mexico, you've got it for six months. You can go anywhere, any fishing village,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: any little town, any little place, show them this and you're welcome. If you don't have that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: you go straight to jail. So you go down there and you think, okay, they're going to have fuel for me

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: to come back and so forth. Oh, sorry, senor, that had a rusty leak in it. We don't have any. Well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: you better be able to go to town and get it. So that's what I did. And when I was coming back for

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: several years, I would fly up at Mexicali and cross the border right at Calexico. I would act

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: like I was landing on the Calexico side just after dark and then I would zip across the border and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I'd go over to the Salton Sea and go below sea level, 100 and something feet, I believe 170 feet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and come on up and go out there above Palm Springs and land out 29 Palms in the desert

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and put my stuff under a Joshua tree and fly into town and get my pickup and go on back out and get

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: it. And that was fun. And then it got really dangerous. They had Operation Starlight, I believe

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: was the name of it, and they caught a lot of pilots coming across the border. So I changed it. And by

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: that time, I was flying bigger planes. I was flying beach 18s. And I would refuel in Mula,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: halfway down on Baja Peninsula. And then over in the middle, 20 miles from the nearest road was a

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: goat ranch where they milk goats and made cheese. And I would go there and unload the load coming

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: up out of anywhere in southern Mexico. And I would land there and a guy named Juan,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: we'd put the marijuana under the trees and I'd fly into Mula and they'd wash my plane and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: gas it up. I'd eat lunch and rent a room for a few hours and take a nap and a shower,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and then go back in the afternoon and fill up. And then I would go northwest out of there

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and fly 200 miles off the coast of the island of Guadalupe. And from there, I would fly on a more

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: northwestern heading about 300 miles out over the Pacific. And then I would come in behind the Santa

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Barbara Islands down low and then I'd come up and go out in the desert and land. And I did that for

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the rest of the marijuana trips. What was the hardest part about flying those routes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: The hardest part was getting good marijuana. So the hardest part isn't the flying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: No, the flying. Just like driving your car down. But then I had people that would bring me on

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: strips that were just unworthy of an airplane. I'd land on a highway. And in the rainy season,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I would come back to land again and the guy wouldn't think about it and he'd have little

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: hills on both sides and the wings were out there. Well, the grass and the weeds would grow up and it

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: sounded like, I mean, it sounded like tearing the airplane apart when those wings hit, mowing the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: grass down both shoulders of the airplane. The weeds would grow up high in the tropics. So some

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: of that stuff was bad and getting bad gasoline and telling me that land here in the light and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: knock the wheels off when you land. Oh, you should have landed a little further up here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Senor. They ditched down. That sort of thing. What was it like landing on a highway? And

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: when did you have to land on a highway? I landed on a highway most of my life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: most of the times. In Mexico, first time I went down, there was a place called Pichulingui.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And you had a 900-foot strip and I would fly down and I'd carry gasoline with me and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Mari and I would go to the grocery store and buy all kinds of little goodies and candies and toys

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: to bring to the children. And that sand strip in the bend of a river was just too short to take

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: off with a load. So there was a young man there named Pedro, must not weigh much over 100, maybe

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: 120 pounds, and he'd get in a plane with me. And he'd direct me 20, 30, 40 miles away to a highway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And the people, walking, and the people would pull out in a two-ton truck with a machine gun on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And a bunch of guys with arms were just, and they'd block the road and then another one would block

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: it up about a mile away and I'd land right over that truck. And they had loaded me up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: looked like a bucket brigade with the marijuana coming. I'd shake hands with all of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Then I'd take off right over the other trucks. And sometimes maybe 20, 30, 40 cars lined up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: One time I remember a highway patrol car. He didn't have his lights on. I took off right over

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: him. And then when I started flying to Louisiana, the bridge over the Mississippi River, there were

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: several contractors that went broke. And that thing was out for years. And about five miles from the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: river was flashing red lights and a detour. And then they swamp on both sides of it, in the middle

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: of it, we'd grown up with 20 feet trees. And that was like an international runway from anywhere in

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the world. So I landed on that and over and over those red lights, just like the end of a runway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And then the next morning we'd go out there and scrub the marks off the highway where I'd landed

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: before daylight. Wow. Let's go to somebody you've known well, somebody who is also a drug smuggler

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: is Barry Seal. Who is Barry Seal? How did you meet him? Barry Seal is a friend of mine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Mari and I and the children went down in Honduras and we went up Lake Azul, I believe it was,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and we were looking at a ranch to buy. I was looking for something in Central America where

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I'd have a halfway place. Oh, it was lovely. We stayed up there for some days and our clothes

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: got muddy and we went in the river and all kinds of things. So we got to San Pedro Sula and we was

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: going back to New Orleans. So we went to the cleaners to get our clothes and most all of them was in

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: there. And they go, oh, Senor, they'll be ready tomorrow morning. We're not ready now. Well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the plane leaves at nine o'clock or whatever. So I told Mari for her and the children to go into

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the airport because it'd be easier for one on a standby flight. So I went to the laundromat for

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the clothes and they were ready and they was a pile of them. And I put them on my back and got

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: into taxi and the old taxi were driving with it and I'd give him a hundred dollars to go faster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He just blew his horn more rapid. Finally, we got to the airport and I jumped out and ran around

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: on the tarmac and here's a brand new 727 taxiing out. Oh, no. So I'm waving to the pilot and he's

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: a young fellow. He waves back. Then I see Mari's face in the cockpit and the nose goes down where

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: he puts on brakes and he laughs and he puts some stairwell out. And I run for the stairwell and he

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: pulls it back up and goes like a hitchhiker, going to pick you up and go again. Then he put it out

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and I got on and the whole crowd's clapped and I'm coming on with that load of clothes. So I go way

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: down in the middle and the plane's full and Miriam, my daughter, is about nine years old then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: She was sitting in the middle and by the window was Barry Seale. Of course, I didn't know it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And I sat in the middle and we took off and the wheels come up with clunk and then I got up about

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: 5,000 feet and we had a little clink, clink, clink. And she said, what was that, daddy? I said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: he just turned on his autopilot. That fellow reached over and I looked at him. I said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: he looks like CIA or FBI, something. He ain't supposed to be here. Clear blue eyes, gentleman

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: looking man. And he said, you fly these things? I said, I got a few hours, mister. He said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I'll fly them too or something or other. And he said, my name's Barry Seale. And he reached over

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Miriam and shook hands and we got to talking. And I thought, there's no choice or seats on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: It's just open seating. But I don't believe him one bit. And he started talking about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: he just got out of jail that morning, just got out of prison. And I said, uh-huh.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And he told me that he'd been a pilot with TWA and this and other. And he told me what he was

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: for. And so we had a nice conversation for a couple of hours to New Orleans. I didn't believe

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: him. So he got off in front of us and what a crowd of people to meet him. An old mother and a wife

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and little children hanging on to him, crying and hugging and kissing. I said, he was telling the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: truth. So I reached over and gave him a little piece of paper. I had Murray to write it out

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: with our address. I said, Barry, I might have some work for you. What was he in jail for?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He got caught with a hundred kilos of cocaine in a small plane. And so he served a year. And that

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: was from Colombia? I don't know where it comes from. He got caught in Honduras, probably refueling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: But he'd been in prison down there before for bringing explosives to the Cuban Contras.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And he lost his job with the airlines. And then later on I found out he was ex-CIA and George

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Bush senior's protege and had a thousand parachute jumps and was there. He was a hot shot mouth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: There's a million questions I want to ask here, but maybe can we linger on it a little bit longer?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: What was your relationship with him like? You were a drug smuggler. He's a drug smuggler.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: You're friends. How often do you guys talk? How often do you work together?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: What was the relationship like? Well, I'll back up and just finish where I started off there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: over and see if it was... And it still ain't dawned on me. And Pedro was yelling, police here, police

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: here, Roger, police here. Well, it dawned on me and I shoved the throttle to the firewall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So that was a bullet? Yeah. They had shot it. They'd shot it, just a warning, like get out,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: stop. We're going to rob you. Whatever it is. That's what they do. They had taken the plane

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and put me in prison, the old thing. But even though I had papers. So I just shoved it to the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: firewall and they weren't enough room to take off on that strip. And half of it was behind me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: or some of it was behind me. And so just at the end, I'm just like, I think that thing stalled

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: at about 50 miles an hour, just turning 50. And I just pulled it right up and put the flaps on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And as I pulled off the ground, they opened up on both sides of me with machine guns and they

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: riddled that airplane. I mean, the windshield came out. I got hit three times. Like your body?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Yeah. But I didn't know I was hit. I mean, it was just the gasoline just pouring in. The world

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: turned yellow. I must have went into shock. So it just stopped in slow motion. And one bullet hit

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the strut right by my head and parts of that bullet just went all over me. I just looked like

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I'd been peppered with lead. And the gasoline was just pouring in. I'm just pouring in where they'd

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: shot the wing up above and the windshield's gone. I mean, I can't remember, but it was just like

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: a hail storm. So I- The airplane's stalled or no?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I was in a stall anyway, and I didn't realize it. And I guess you wouldn't unless you trained for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: But when you're in a stall, the elevator is kind of flappy. And I didn't realize it at the time. I

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: thought they had shot the elevator cable in too. So I thought, oh God. So I just reached over and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: switched it off, switched it, pulled the mixture, pulled everything. And in the river, there was

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: rocks about as big as this table. And they were like the turtle back all the way up until there

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: was a waterfall. It was quite a pretty place. And I crashed straight onto it. I thought, if I get

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: those rocks. And when I did, the first time I hit, the wings came off and then it bounced. And the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: next time the nose came up and came under the plane, and I'm sitting there, I must have been

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: knocked unconscious, because Pedro's shaking me. Come on, Roger. Come on, Roger. So I stepped out

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: into the water. And here comes these four Federalis still shooting at us. And a bullet or two hit the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: airplane. And I kept a nine millimeter Browning high power taped to the top of the radio, in case

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I ever needed it. Because you didn't want it in the airplane. So it was just handy, just laying

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: there. So I took and popped a few caps out of them and they ran into the rocks. So we took off

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: running. And then I looked and Pedro's foot nearly shot off. They'd shot him on one side, the ankle

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and it just blown out the other side. And it wasn't even hardly bleeding, the shock of it. So I took

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: my t-shirt off and gripped it and tied it best I could. But you had still bullets in you. So like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: you could still run. I shot the top of my toenail off. I shot it off across my head and my knee cap.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So I was just nicked. It was very painful later on, but right that time, it was just hot. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: there's a bullet still in my foot from it, a piece of a bullet, good size slug. So we went on up the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: mountain through the cactus and- Just running. Just going, I want to go down. No, no, they'll

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: fell all as they go in the easy way. Let's go, this young fella. And we came to an old donkey.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: She must've been 30 years old, long and sway back, long hair on her. Charlotte, Charlotte.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And he petted the donkey and we jumped down. Like an actual donkey?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: A donkey. There were donkeys all over the place. He knew that one from the village.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And so we rode seven miles, two of us on a donkey with no bridle, no saddle, nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And we came to a little man plowing a little horse and a little ox. Both of them spotted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And the ox was, the yoke was across her back this way and he's plowing with a little plow

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: amongst dumps. It was like one of these people clearing a little piece of land. And he had a

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: little house there. And so we went into his house and his wife and his daughter, they put like a

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: cloth over my wounds and on Pedro's. It was terrible. And they poured diesel oil on it to

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: keep the flies off. So I'm covered in diesel. So the man left and he was going all day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And then about dark, he showed up about 15 or 20 horses and mules showed up in the yard,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: walking fast. And the doctor got out, he said, I'm Dr. Benjamin So-so with Red Cross.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And he worked on my foot and he worked on Pedro. He gave us a shot of morphine and tetanus shots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And he said, you got to get to hospital. He said, Pedro will die if he don't get to hospital.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He said, they're looking for American pilots been shot down. They think he's dead. There was a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: of blood in that airplane. And so they rode, I don't know how far we rode, but we rode miles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And we'd come to a road and there was a big truck and it was loaded with corn in the ear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And they dug holes in that corn, put us in it and covered us up. And the road was rough. And every

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: time we'd hit a dirt road, that corn would cover me up. They'd scratch my face out again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And when it came to the highway, we went into a house and they got me some clothes. Mine was

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: messed up. And a white basin and they must've brought 20 jugs of water different times. I

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: kept washing and washing my foot till all the blood and the crud got off of me and put on those

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: clothes. And somebody went to, they said, you can't go north of Roads Block. They're looking for the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: pilot. So you got to go south. So they found a taxi in Mazatlan and it was a rather new taxi.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And the fellow would take me to Guadalajara, which was, I don't know, seven, eight hours south.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So we got in that taxi and they propped me up with sheets and blankets and pillows in the back seat

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and gave me these great big white pain pills. And I was quite content. Then I was shot down

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: in Columbia also. Can you tell that story?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I sure can. All right. I went down for a load of marijuana and we got to the place

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and we got there too early and the guerrillas screamed, you got to get out of here. You got

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: to get out of here. And so we went back to the place where we staged from and refueled. I had a

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: beautiful DC-3, carry three tons. And so while I was waiting, I ate something for lunch and I went

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: around behind the house. We refueled the plane up. I had to wait till late afternoon. They wanted me

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: to come just at dark so the military planes couldn't see me on their strip.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So I'm leaning in a hammock asleep and I hear this terrible roar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And I looked right up through the trees and at the ass end of two military jets going straight up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: They do a dive over and they came back down the strip in front of that airplane

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and they just tear it up with 50 caliber machine guns. They just showing out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So I run for the airplane. I just give that guy $80,000 and he ran for the truck and all the rest

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: of them ran for the truck. I should have ran with my money. But I didn't. I ran for the airplane.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And the copilot got in and his name was Al. He got in with me and two fellows got in the back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: We had drums of fuel in there to refuel when we got down to the guerrillas. So we took off

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and I couldn't get the gear up because I'd taken off in such a hurry. These pins in the struts of

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: a DC-3 and with big flags on them and you have to take them up so that the plane won't come up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So these jets swarmed on me and they tried to get me to go. They kept telling me which way to go

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and the pilot would be just as close as just right over there. I could see him. I just held up the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: old hippie piece. I didn't think they would shoot. I really didn't. Nobody had shot before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So I kept flying out and I kept getting slower and slower and they kept slowing down, down, down and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the black smoke rolling. And then they started shooting up under me. Boom, boom, boom, boom with

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: them 20-millimeter cannons. And then the tracers just going up. They looked like they were curving

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: up from me. I wooed and I pushed the nose over so they couldn't get under me. And later on I heard

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: they thought I tried to ram them. So one of them went for fuel and I kept on going. And the one

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: just tore the left wing tip up with the.50 caliber. And then he'd come back again and shot the tail up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: He's warning me. And I tell the fellow in there, I says, you know, if you bring me enough water,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I believe I can fly this thing. My mouth got quite dry. So I went on and I landed on a big pasture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And it was huge pasture and it was rougher than it looked and the wings just flapped. And I come

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: to a stop and jumped out and pulled those tabs out and threw them on the ground so I could get

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: my gear up. And I understand that during the 1980 World Series baseball game that it says,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: American DC-3 has just been shot down by American jets, by Colombian jets. It's the first plane

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: shot down on Reagan's New World on drugs. But he's up. He's up and away, ladies and gentlemen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: We'll keep you posted. So I took off again and I went into a thunderstorm and they came close to

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: the mountains. So I spiraled up and every time I'd come out, that jet was there, boom, boom, boom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And I dove back into that storm, boom, boom, boom in there. And at 20,000 feet, I started icing up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So I went out one last time and he was right there waiting. He had me on radar. So I went back in and

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I kicked it over and put it into a spin and went straight down to 2,000 feet and come out under it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And I was flying along the Guaviera River and it was 20 feet above the water. It looked like a

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: pasture. It was just grass. And I made several runs to tear the grass down and it looked like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and it felt hard. That old DC-3 weighs 30,000 pounds. And I put it down on the fifth run.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I said, all right, Al, we're going to land now. And as I was-

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So you flew like close several times?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I put the wheels down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Oh, you put the wheels down without landing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: About half a mile. So I'm making a run for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So you're being tracked by a jet. He's trying to, well, before that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I'm just retelling this story how insane it is. So he's trying to shoot you down and there's a

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: thunderstorm that you're escaping into. And then you do a spin down to what, 2,000 feet, whatever

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: you said, like somehow escaping all of this. And then you try to land on a pasture on a giant,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: heavy plane that carries three tons by touching down five or six times to make a landing strip

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: for yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Yeah. The grass is three or four feet high. So it looked really good after a few times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: So then just before it stopped, I said, Al, take your feet off the brakes. He said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: I don't have my feet on the brakes. Well, I knew I had broken through the crust

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: and I put full power on, but it didn't. That old big plane just come on down and it just did a head

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: as it came to a stop, it did a headstand, 90 degrees to the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: Oh, wow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: And the engines held it up and the nose and all just crushed in right on it. We fell between the

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: two seats to keep from getting killed. And when it come to a stop, all that fuel was pouring out

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: on those hot engines and there's a scape hatch at the top. I just stepped out, took my suitcase,

metadata.title: Podcast: Roger Reaves: Smuggling Drugs for Pablo Escobar and the Medellin Cartel | Lex Fridman Podcast #199

body.input: with me.
