body.input: And now, here's my conversation with Ben and his wife,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Kurtzl.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: What books, authors, ideas had a lot of impact on you

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: in your life in the early days?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: You know, what got me into AI and science fiction

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and such in the first place wasn't a book,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but the original Star Trek TV show,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which my dad watched with me in its first run.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: It would have been 1968, 69 or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And that was incredible,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: because every show that visited a different alien civilization

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: with different culture and weird mechanisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But that got me into science fiction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and there wasn't that much science fiction

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to watch on TV at that stage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: That got me into reading the whole literature

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of science fiction from the beginning

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of the previous century until that time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And I mean, there was so many science fiction writers

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: who were inspirational to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I'd say if I had to pick two,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: it would have been Stanislaw Lem, the Polish writer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah, Solaris, and then he had a bunch

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of more obscure writings on superhuman AIs

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: that were engineered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Solaris was sort of a superhuman,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: naturally occurring intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Then Philip K. Dick, who, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: ultimately my fandom for Philip K. Dick

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: is one of the things that brought me together

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: with David Hansen, my collaborator

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: on robotics projects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So, you know, Stanislaw Lem was very much

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: an intellectual, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So he had a very broad view of intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: going beyond the human and into what I would call,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: you know, open-ended superintelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: The Solaris superintelligent ocean was intelligent

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: in some ways more generally intelligent than people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but in a complex and confusing way

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: so that human beings could never quite connect to it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but it was still probably very, very smart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And then the Golem IV supercomputer

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: in one of Lem's books, this was engineered by people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but eventually it became very intelligent

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: in a different direction than humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and decided that humans were kind of trivial,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: not that interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So it put some impenetrable shield around itself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: shut itself off from humanity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and then issued some philosophical screed

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: about the pathetic and hopeless nature of humanity

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and all human thought, and then disappeared.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Now, Philip K. Dick, he was a bit different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: He was human focused, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: His main thing was, you know, human compassion

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and the human heart and soul are going to be the constant

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: that will keep us going through whatever aliens we discover

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: or telepathy machines or super AIs or whatever it might be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So he didn't believe in reality,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: like the reality that we see may be a simulation

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: or a dream or something else we can't even comprehend,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but he believed in love and compassion

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: as something persistent through the various simulated

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: realities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So those two science fiction writers had a huge impact on me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Then a little older than that, I got into Dostoevsky

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and Friedrich Nietzsche and Rimbaud

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and a bunch of more literary typewriters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Can we talk about some of those things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So on the Solaris side, Stanislav Lem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: this kind of idea of there being intelligences out there

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: that are different than our own,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: do you think there are intelligences maybe all around us

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: that we're not able to even detect?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So this kind of idea of, maybe you can comment also

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: on Steven Wolfram thinking that there's computations

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: all around us and we're just not smart enough

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to kind of detect their intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: or appreciate their intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah, so my friend Hugo de Gares,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: who I've been talking to about these things

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: for many decades since their early 90s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: he had an idea he called SIPI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: the search for intra-particulate intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So the concept there was as AIs get smarter

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and smarter and smarter,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: assuming the laws of physics as we know them now

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: are still what these super intelligences

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: perceive to hold and are bound by,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: as they get smarter and smarter,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: they're gonna shrink themselves littler and littler

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: because special relativity makes it sort of communicate

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: between two spatially distant points.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So they're gonna get smaller and smaller,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but then ultimately, what does that mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: The minds of the super, super, super intelligences,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: they're gonna be packed into the interaction

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of elementary particles or quarks

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: or the partons and side quarks or whatever it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So what we perceive as random fluctuations

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: on the quantum or sub-quantum level

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: may actually be the thoughts

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of the micro, micro, micro-miniaturized super intelligences

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: because there's no way we can tell random from structured,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but with an algorithmic information

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: more complex than our brains, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: We can't tell the difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So what we think is random could be the thought processes

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of some really tiny super minds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And if so, there is not a damn thing we can do about it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: except try to upgrade our intelligences

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and expand our minds so that we can perceive more

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of what's around us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But if those random fluctuations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: even if we go to quantum mechanics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: if that's actually super intelligent systems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: aren't we then part of the soup of super intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Aren't we just like a finger of the entirety

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of the body of the super intelligence system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: It could be, I mean, a finger is a strange metaphor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I mean, we-

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Well, a finger is dumb is what I mean.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But the finger is also useful

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and is controlled with intent by the brain,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: whereas we may be much less than that, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I mean, yeah, we may be just some random epiphenomenon

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: that they don't care about too much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Like think about the shape of the crowd

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: emanating from a sports stadium or something, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: There's some emergent shape to the crowd.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: It's there, you could take a picture of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And AGI seems immediately comprehensible

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to people with a technical background.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So I think that the term has served as sociological function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Now it's out there everywhere, which baffles me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: It's like KFC.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I mean, that's it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: We're stuck with AGI probably for a very long time

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: until AGI systems take over and rename themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And then we'll be biological-

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: We're stuck with GPUs too,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which mostly have nothing to do with graphics anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I wonder what the AGI system will call us humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: That was maybe-

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Grandpa.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: GPs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Grandpa processing unit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Biological grandpa processing units.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Okay. So maybe also just a comment on AGI representing

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: before even the term existed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: representing a kind of community.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: You've talked about this in the past,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: sort of AI has come in waves,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but there's always been this community of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: who dream about creating general human levels,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: super intelligence systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Can you maybe give your sense of the history

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of this community as it exists today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: as it existed before this deep learning revolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: all throughout the winters and the summers of AI?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: First, I would say as a side point,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: the winters and summers of AI are greatly exaggerated

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: by Americans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And if you look at the publication record

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of the artificial intelligence community

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: since say the 1950s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: you would find a pretty steady growth

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and advance of ideas and papers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And what's thought of as an AI winter or summer

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: was sort of how much money is the US military

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: pumping into AI, which was meaningful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: On the other hand, there was AI going on in Germany,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: UK, and Japan, and Russia, all over the place,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: while US military got more and less enthused about AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So, I mean-

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: That happened to be, just for people who don't know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: the US military happened to be the main source

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of funding for AI research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So another way to phrase that is it's up and down

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of funding for artificial intelligence research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: It's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And I would say the correlation between funding

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and intellectual advance was not 100%, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Because I mean, in Russia, as an example, or in Germany,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: there was less dollar funding than in the US,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but many foundational ideas were laid out,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but it was more theory than implementation, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And US really excelled at sort of breaking through

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: from theoretical papers to working implementations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which did go up and down somewhat

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: with US military funding,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but still, I mean, you can look in the 1980s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Dietrich Dörner in Germany had self-driving cars

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: on the Autobahn, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And I mean, this, it was a little early

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: with regard to the car industry,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: so it didn't catch on such as has happened now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but I mean, that whole advancement

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of self-driving car technology in Germany

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: was pretty much independent of AI military summers

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and winters in the US.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So there's been more going on in AI globally

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: than not only most people on the planet realize,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but then most new AI PhDs realize,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: because they've come up within a certain sub field of AI

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and haven't had to look so much beyond that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But I would say when I got my PhD in 1989 in mathematics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I was interested in AI already.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: In Philadelphia, by the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah, I started at NYU, then I transferred to Philadelphia

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to Temple University, good old North Philly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: North Philly, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah, yeah, yeah, the pearl of the US.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah, you never stopped at a red light then

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: because you were afraid if you stopped at a red light,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: so more carjacking, so you just drive through every red light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Is it every day driving or bicycling to Temple from my house

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: was like a new adventure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But yeah, the reason I didn't do a PhD in AI

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: was what people were doing in the academic AI field then

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: was just astoundingly boring and seemed wrongheaded to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: It was really like rule-based expert systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and production systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And actually I loved mathematical logic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I had nothing against logic as the cognitive engine

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: for an AI, but the idea that you could type in the knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: that AI would need to think seemed just completely stupid

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and wrongheaded to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I mean, you can use logic if you want,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but somehow the system has got to be-

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Automated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Learning, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: It should be learning from experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And the AI field then was not interested

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: in learning from experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I mean, some researchers certainly were.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I mean, I remember in mid-80s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I discovered a book by John Andreas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which was, it was about reinforcement learning system

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: called PURPUS, P-U-R-R dash P-U-S-S,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which was an acronym that I can't even remember

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: what it was for, but PURPUS anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But he, I mean, that was a system

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: that was supposed to be an AGI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And basically by some sort of fancy

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: like Markov decision process learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: it was supposed to learn everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: just from the bits coming into it

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and learn to maximize its reward

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and become intelligent, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So that was there in academia back then,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but it was like isolated, scattered, weird people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But all these isolated, scattered,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: weird people in that period,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I mean, they laid the intellectual grounds

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: for what happened later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So you look at John Andreas at University of Canterbury

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: with his PURPUS reinforcement learning Markov system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: He was the PhD supervisor for John Cleary in New Zealand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Now, John Cleary worked with me

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: when I was at Waikato University in 1993 in New Zealand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And he worked with Ian Whitten there

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and they launched Weka,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which was the first open source machine learning toolkit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which was launched in, I guess, 93 or 94

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: when I was at Waikato University.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Written in Java, unfortunately.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Written in Java, which was a cool language back then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I guess it's still, well, it's not cool anymore,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but it's powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I find, like most programmers now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I find Java unnecessarily bloated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But back then it was like Java or C++ basically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And Java was- Object-oriented, so it's nice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Java was easier for students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Amusingly, a lot of the work on Weka

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: when we were in New Zealand was funded by a US,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: sorry, a New Zealand government grant

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to use machine learning

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to predict the menstrual cycles of cows.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So in the US, all the grant funding for AI

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: was about how to kill people or spy on people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: In New Zealand, it's all about cows or kiwi fruits, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So yeah, anyway, I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: John Andreas had his probability theory-based

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: reinforcement learning, proto-AGI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: John Cleary was trying to do much more ambitious,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: probabilistic AGI systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Now, John Cleary helped do Weka,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which is the first open source machine learning tool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Gets it a predecessor for TensorFlow and Torch

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and all these things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Also, Shane Legge was at Waikato

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: working with John Cleary and Ian Winton

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and this whole group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And then working with my own company,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: my company Webmind, an AI company I had in the late 90s

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: with a team there at Waikato University,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which is how Shane got his head full of AGI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which led him to go on

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and with Demisys Habis found DeepMind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So what you can see through that lineage is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: in the 80s and 70s, John Andreas was trying to build

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: probabilistic reinforcement learning AGI systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: The technology, the computers just weren't there to support.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: His ideas were very similar to what people are doing now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But although he's long since passed away

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and didn't become that famous outside of Canterbury,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I mean, the lineage of ideas passed on from him

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to his students to their students,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: you can go trace directly from there to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and to DeepMind, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So there was a lot going on in AGI

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: that did ultimately lay the groundwork for what we have today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but there wasn't a community, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah, so you have a hypergraph, which is like a,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: so a graph in this sense is a bunch of nodes

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: with links between them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: A hypergraph is like a graph

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but links can go between more than two nodes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So you have a link between three nodes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And in fact, OpenCog's AtomSpace

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: would properly be called a metagraph

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: because you can have links pointing to links,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: or you could have links pointing to whole subgraphs, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So it's an extended hypergraph or a metagraph.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Is metagraph a technical term?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: It is now a technical term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But I don't think it was yet a technical term

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: when we started calling this a generalized hypergraph.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But in any case, it's a weighted labeled

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: generalized hypergraph or weighted labeled metagraph.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: The weights and labels mean that the nodes and links

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: can have numbers and symbols attached to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So they can have types on them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: they can have numbers on them that represent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: say a truth value or an importance value

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: for a certain purpose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And of course, like with all things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: you can reduce that to a hypergraph

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and then the hypergraph can be reduced to a graph.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: You can reduce the hypergraph to a graph

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and you can reduce the graph to an adjacency matrix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So I mean, there's always multiple representation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But there's a layer of representation

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: that seems to work well here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Got it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Right, right, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And so similarly, you could have a link to a whole graph

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: because a whole graph could represent, say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: a body of information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And I could say, I reject this body of information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Then one way to do that is make that link go

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to that whole subgraph representing

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: the body of information, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I mean, there are many alternate representations

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: but that's, anyway, what we have in OpenCog,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: we have an AdminSpace, which is this weighted label,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: generalized hypergraph, knowledge store.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: It lives in RAM.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: There's also a way to back it up to disk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: There are ways to spread it among

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: multiple different machines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Then there are various utilities for dealing with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So there's a pattern matcher,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which lets you specify a sort of abstract pattern

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and then search through a whole array of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So you can see that there's a whole AdminSpace

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: weighted label hypergraph to see what sub-hypergraphs

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: may match that pattern, for an example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So then there's something called the cog server in OpenCog

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which lets you run a bunch of different agents or processes

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: in a scheduler and each of these agents,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: basically it reads stuff from the AdminSpace

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and it writes stuff to the AdminSpace.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So it's like an operational model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: That's the software framework.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Right, and of course there's a lot there

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: just from a scalable software engineering standpoint.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So you can use this, I don't know if you've,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: have you looked into the Steven Wolfram's physics project

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: recently with the hypergraphs and stuff?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Well, that's, yeah, but there's a big community of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And like you said, the young minds love the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: of integrating, of connecting things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah, yeah, that's right.

body.input: And I would add on that note,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: the idea of using hypergraph type models in physics

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But yeah, Wolfram aside, yes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But one key part is switching from predicate logic

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So term logic was invented by Aristotle,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: or at least that's the oldest recollection we have of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But term logic breaks down basic logic into basically simple

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: links between nodes, like an inheritance link between node

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: A and node B. So in term logic, the basic deduction operation

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: is A implies B, B implies C. Therefore, A implies C.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Whereas in predicate logic, the basic operation

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: is modus ponens, like A implies B, therefore B.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So there's a slightly different way of breaking down logic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But by breaking down logic into term logic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: you get a nice way of breaking logic down into nodes and links.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So your concepts can become nodes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: The logical relations become links.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And so then inference is like, so if this link is A implies B,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: this link is B implies C, then deduction builds a link,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: A implies C. And your probabilistic algorithm

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: can assign a certain weight there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Now, you may also have a Hebbian neural link

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: from A to C, which is the degree to which A being

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So you could have then a neural link.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And you could have a symbolic, logical inheritance

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: link in your term logic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And they have separate meaning, but they

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: could be used to guide each other as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Like, if there is a large amount of neural weight

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: on the link between A and B, that

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: may direct your logic engine to think about, well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: what is the relation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Is there an inheritance relation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Are they similar in some context?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: On the other hand, if there's a logical relation between A

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and B, that may direct your neural component to think,

body.input: be directing some attention to B also?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Because there's a logical relation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So in terms of logic, there's a lot of thought that went into,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: how do you break down logic relations, including

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: as Aristotelian term logic deals with,

body.input: and then quantifier logic relations also?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: so that when you have a neural net acting

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: on the same nodes and links, the neural net

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and the logic engine can sort of interoperate with each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: And also interpretable by humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Is that an important?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: That's tough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: In simple cases, it's interpretable by humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But honestly, I would say logic systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: give more potential for transparency

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and comprehensibility than neural net systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But you still have to work at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Because if I show you a predicate logic proposition

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: with 500 nested universal and existential quantifiers

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and 217 variables, that's no more comprehensible

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: than the weight matrix of a neural network, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So I'd say the logic expressions that an AI learns

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: from its experience are mostly totally opaque to human beings

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and maybe even harder to understand than a neural net.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Because when you have multiple nested quantifier bindings,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: it's a very high level of abstraction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: There is a difference, though, in that within logic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: it's a little more straightforward

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to pose the problem of normalize this and boil this down

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to a certain form.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I mean, you can do that in neural nets, too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: You can distill a neural net to a simpler form.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But that's more often done to make a neural net that'll run

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: on an embedded device or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: It's harder to distill a net to a comprehensible form

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: than is to simplify a logic expression

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to a comprehensible form.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But it doesn't come for free.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: What's in the AI's mind is incomprehensible to a human

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: unless you do some special work to make it comprehensible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So on the procedural side, there's some different

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and sort of interesting voodoo there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: I mean, if you're familiar in computer science,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: there's something called the Curry-Howard correspondence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: which is a one-to-one mapping between proofs and programs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So every program can be mapped into a proof.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Every proof can be mapped into a program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: You can model this using category theory

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and a bunch of nice math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But we wanna make that practical, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So that if you have an executable program

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: that moves a robot's arm or figures out in what order

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: to say things in a dialogue, that's a procedure

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: represented in OpenCog's hypergraph.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But if you wanna reason on how to improve that procedure,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: you need to map that procedure into logic

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: using Curry-Howard isomorphism

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: so then the logic engine can reason about

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: how to improve that procedure

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and then map that back into the procedural representation

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: that is efficient for execution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So again, that comes down to not just can you make

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: your procedure into a bunch of nodes and links,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: because I mean, that can be done trivially.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: A C++ compiler has nodes and links inside it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Can you boil down your procedure into a bunch of nodes

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and links in a way that's like hierarchically decomposed

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: and simple enough?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So you can reason about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: Yeah, yeah, given the resource constraints at hand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: you can map it back and forth to your term logic

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: like fast enough and without having

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: a bloated logic expression, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So there's just a lot of nitty gritty particulars there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: But by the same token, if you ask a chip designer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Goertzel: Artificial General Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #103

body.input: So yeah, he's interested in not just Sophia,
