metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Yeah, I'd be happy to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: because I teach a course at NYU in the business school

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: called Work Wisdom and Happiness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And the course is, it's advice on how to have a happy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: a successful career as a human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: But the course has evolved that it's now about three things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: how to get stronger, smarter, and more sociable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: If you can do those three things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: then you will be more successful

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: at work and in love and friendships.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And if you are more successful in work, love,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and friendships, then you will be happier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: You will be as happy as you can be, in fact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: So the question is, how do you become smarter,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: stronger, and happier?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And the answer to all three is, it's a number of things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: but it's you have to see yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: as this like complex adaptive system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: You've got this complicated mind

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: that needs a lot of experience to wire itself up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And the most important part of that experience is

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: that you don't grow when you are with your attachment figure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: You don't grow when you're safe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: You have an attachment figure to make you feel confident

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: to go out and explore the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: In that world, you will face threats, you will face fear,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and sometimes you'll come running back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: But you have to keep doing it because over time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: you then develop the strength to stay out there

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and to conquer it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: That's normal human childhood.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: That's what we blocked in the 1990s in this country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: So young people have to get themselves the childhood,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and this is all the way through adolescence

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and young adulthood, they have to get themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: the experience that older generations are blocking them

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: from out of fear and that their phones are blocking them

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: from out of just hijacking almost all the inputs

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: into their life and almost all the minutes of their day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: So go out there, put yourself out in experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: You are anti-fragile and you're not gonna get strong

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: unless you actually have setbacks

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and criticisms and fights.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: So that's how you get stronger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And then there's an analogy in how you get smarter,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: which is you have to expose yourself to other ideas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: to ideas that people that criticize you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: people that disagree with you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And this is why I co-founded Heterodox Academy

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: because we believe that faculty need to be in communities

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: that have political diversity and viewpoint diversity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: but so do students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And it turns out students want this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: The surveys show very clearly Gen Z has not turned again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Gen Z has not turned against viewpoint diversity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Most of them want it, but they're just afraid

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: of the small number that will sort of shoot darts at them

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: if they say something wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: So anyway, the point is you're anti-fragile.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And so you have to realize that to get stronger,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: you have to realize to get smarter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And then the key to becoming more sociable is very simple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: It's just always looking at through

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: the other person's point of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Don't be so focused on what you want

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and what you're afraid of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Put yourself in the other person's shoes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: What's interesting to them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: What do they want?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And if you develop the skill of looking at it

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: from their point of view,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: you'll be a better conversation partner.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: You'll be a better life partner.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: So there's a lot that you can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: I mean, I could say, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: go read The Collector of the American Mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: I could say go read Dale Carnegie,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: How to Win Friends and Influence People,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: but take charge of your life and your development.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Because if you don't do it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: then the older protective generation and your phone

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: are gonna take charge of you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: So on antifragility and coddling the American mind,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: if I may read just a few lines

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: from Chief Justice John Roberts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: which I find is really beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: So it's not just about viewpoint diversity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: but it's real struggle, absurd, unfair struggle

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: that seems to be formative to the human mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: He says, from time to time and the years to come,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: I hope you will be treated unfairly

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: so that you will come to know the value of justice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: I hope that you will suffer betrayal

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: because that will teach you the importance of loyalty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Sorry to say, but I hope you will be lonely from time to time

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: so that you don't take friends for granted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: I wish you bad luck again from time to time

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: so that you will be conscious of the role of chance in life

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and understand that your success is not completely deserved

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and that the failure of others

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: is not completely deserved either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And when you lose, as you will from time to time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: I hope every now and then

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: your opponent will gloat over your failure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: It is a way for you to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: the importance of sportsmanship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: I hope you'll be ignored

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: so you know the importance of listening to others

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and I hope you will have just enough pain

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: to learn compassion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Whether I wish these things or not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: they're going to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And whether you benefit from them or not

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: will depend upon your ability

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: to see the message in your misfortunes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: He read that in a middle school graduation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Yes, for his son's, his son's middle school graduation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: That's what I was trying to say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: only that's much more beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Yeah, and I think your work is really important

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and it is beautiful and it's bold and fearless

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: and it's a huge honor that you will sit with me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: I'm a big fan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Thank you for spending your valuable time with me today, John.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Thank you so much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Thanks so much, Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: What a pleasure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Thanks for listening to this conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: with Jonathan Haidt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: To support this podcast,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: please check out our sponsors in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: And now let me leave you with some words from Carl Jung.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Everything that irritates us about others

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: can lead us to an understanding of ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Haidt: The Case Against Social Media | Lex Fridman Podcast #291

body.input: Thank you for listening and hope to see you next time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: What are some painful, inspiring or enlightening experiences

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: from that time that stand out to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Oh my God, painful were all these incredibly complicated,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: stupid bugs that had to be found.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We had a phase where Stanley, our car

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: that eventually won the DARPA challenge,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: would every 30 miles just commit suicide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And we didn't know why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And it ended up to be that in the syncing

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: of two computer clocks, occasionally a clock went backwards

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and that negative time elapsed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Screwed up the entire internal logic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: but it took ages to find this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It was like bugs like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I'd say enlightening is the Stanford team

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: immediately focused on machine learning and on software,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: whereas everybody else seemed to focus

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: on building better hardware.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Our analysis had been a human being

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Why do I have to build a better rental car?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I just should replace the human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And the human being to me was a conjunction of three steps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We had sensors, eyes and ears, mostly eyes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We had brains in the middle, and then we had actuators,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: our hands and our feet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Now the actuators are easy to build.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: The sensors are actually also easy to build.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: What was missing was the brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So we had to build a human brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And nothing clear then to me that the human brain

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: is a learning machine, so why not just train our robot?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So we would build massive machine learning into our machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And with that, we were able to not just learn

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: from human drivers, we had the entire speed control

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: of the vehicle was copied from human driving,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: but also have the robot learn from experience

body.input: where it made a mistake and could recover from it

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and learn from it.

body.input: Synchronization seems to be a problem

body.input: that continues with the robotics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It's a tricky one with drones and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: What does it take to build a thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: a system with so many constraints?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: You have a deadline, no time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: you're unsure about anything really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It's the first time that people really even explore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It's not even sure that anybody can finish

body.input: when we're talking about the race to the desert

body.input: the year before nobody finished.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: What does it take to scramble and finish a product

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I mean, we were very lucky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We were a really small team.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: The core of the team were four people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It was four because five couldn't comfortably sit

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: inside a car, but four could.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And I, as a team leader, my job was to get pizza

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: for everybody and wash the car and stuff like this

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and repair the radiator when it broke and debug the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And we were very kind of open-minded.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We had like no egos involved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We just wanted to see how far we can get.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: What we did really, really well was time management.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We were done with everything a month before the race.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And we froze the entire software a month before the race.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And it turned out, looking at other teams,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: every other team complained if they had just one more week,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: they would have won.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And we decided, you're not gonna fall into that mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: You're gonna be early.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And we had an entire month to shake the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And we actually found two or three minor bugs

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: in the last month that we had to fix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And we were completely prepared when the race occurred.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Okay, so first of all,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: that's such an incredibly rare achievement

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: in terms of being able to be done on time or ahead of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: What do you, how do you do that in your future work?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: What advice do you have in general?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Because it seems to be so rare,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: especially in highly innovative projects like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: People work till the last second.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Well, the nice thing about the Dapagwan Challenge

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: is that the problem was incredibly well-defined.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We were able for a while to drive

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: the old Dapagwan Challenge course,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: which had been used the year before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And then at some reason we were kicked out of the region.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So we had to go to different deserts, the Snorren Desert,

body.input: and we were able to drive desert trails just of the same type.

body.input: So there was never any debate about

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: like what's actually the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We didn't sit down and say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: hey, should we build a car or a plane?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We had to build a car.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: That made it very, very easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Then I studied my own life and life of others

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and realized that the typical mistake that people make

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: that they haven't found yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And it's just, they regret it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It's amazing how much of a urge we have

body.input: That's a beautiful message that's not often heard.

body.input: We make this mistake, and this is a friend of mine,

body.input: I mean, here in Silicon Valley, we're full of engineers

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: an interdisciplinary viewpoint

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: where your problem is dictated

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: by what your closest colleagues believe the problem is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It's very hard to break out and say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: well, there's an entire new field of problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So to give an example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: prior to me working on self-driving cars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I was a roboticist and a machine learning expert,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and I wrote books on robotics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: something called probabilistic robotics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It's a very methods-driven kind of viewpoint of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I built robots that acted in museums as tour guides,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: that led children around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It's something that at the time was moderately challenging.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: When I started working on cars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: several colleagues told me,

body.input: because in our field of robotics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: cars are looked like as a gimmick

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and they're not expressive enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: They can only push this throttle and the brakes.

body.input: And no one came to me and said, wow,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: if you solve that problem, you can save a million lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Among all robotic problems that I've seen in my life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I would say the self-driving car, transportation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So how come the robotics community wasn't all over the place?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And it was because we focused on methods

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and solutions and not on problems.

body.input: Like if you go around today and ask your grandmother,
